source_corrections.finding: The path family is defined for i≤n−2; printed i≤n−1 includes an undefined color. Read only on the already defined domain, now recorded in v2.
Use the parenthetical chain-equivalence inside F, not merely the displayed path relation.
The repeated-edge color-preserving exception is b=r1, whereas a=r0 changes vertex color.
Printed torus ha fails distant commutation for p>2 and repeats b when p=2. Correct hb; source quotient-type proof also has a label slip.
A proposed regular base can have b=c. The companion handles this V4 case by exchanging layers; there is no extra family after the corrected formula.
Transposed pairs corrected to corresponding coordinates.

questions.Problem3: Natural reconstruction iff every proper face-star flag graph is connected, equivalently both incident interval flag graphs connected; ambient flag graph connected. Arbitrary isomorphism only for finite P. No unrestricted infinite claim or priority claim.
